work.confirmCancelText: This record will not count in the statistics.
work.editableInfo: The last record can be corrected within 30 minutes.
work.customHint: For work without a fixed price: enter the amount here

system.title: System status
system.backupHint: Download once a day and keep it on your computer or phone. Everything in one file: database dump, Excel sheet and a restorable copy.
system.cleanupHint: To free up space, or to stop keeping old customer data, you can delete every record before a given date. The backup has to be downloaded first.
system.cleanupNothing: There are no records before this date.
system.archiveHint: Download only the records of a chosen period as a file of its own (Excel + a restorable copy). Useful for keeping a period before you delete it.
system.archiveNothing: There are no records in this period.
system.archiveThisPeriod: Download the archive of the period to delete
system.restoreHint: Pick the .json.gz file from a downloaded backup (zip). Only records missing from the system are added; nothing that exists is changed or deleted.
system.restoreNone: Everything in the backup is already in the system, nothing to add ✓
system.restoreDetail: {{found}} rows in the file · added: {{sessions}} records, {{items}} items, {{users}} employees
system.warnDiskFull: The server disk is almost full ({{pct}}%). New records and backups are at risk.
system.warnBackupMissing: No backup has ever been made.
system.warnBackupStale: Last backup was {{days}} days ago — the nightly backup may not be running.

services.title: Price list
services.priceNote: Price changes do not affect past records; old sessions keep the price they were saved with.
services.customNote: This service has no fixed price; the amount is entered when the record is finished. You can rename it, or deactivate it if you don't need it.

employees.title: Employees
employees.name: Name
employees.usernameHint: No accents and no spaces: letters, digits, dot, hyphen.
employees.passwordHint: At least {{min}} characters. Type one or use "Generate".
employees.passwordNotice: Give this password to the person. It is not shown again after you close this window.
employees.confirmDeleteText: {{name}} will no longer be able to sign in and disappears from the list. Every past record keeps the name "{{name}}" and its revenue unchanged.
employees.deactivateHint: If the person might come back, deactivate instead of deleting: the account stays in the list and is back with one click.
employees.restoreHint: Even after deleting, you can restore the account under "Deleted accounts" below.
employees.deletedNote: The past records and revenue of these people are kept; they just cannot sign in any more.
employees.purgeText: The account {{name}} and ALL of its records will be removed from the database completely.
employees.purgeHint: This cannot be undone and changes your revenue reports retroactively — they will no longer match older monthly reports. Download a backup on the "System" page first.

sessions.title: Records
sessions.confirmCancelText: The record is taken out of the statistics, but not deleted.
sessions.addHint: The services are recorded at today's prices; earlier prices are not stored.
sessions.confirmDeleteText: The record {{date}} · {{name}} · {{total}} will be removed from the database completely.
sessions.deleteHint: This cannot be undone. If you only want to take the record out of the statistics, "Cancel" is enough — cancelled records stay in the list but are not counted.
